reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Partial: fixes only drawers with an autofocus field
summary: After the shown event, focus moves to the drawer’s [autofocus] element; a drawer without one is left unchanged.
caveats: A drawer without an [autofocus] element still drops focus to the page body. The stricter case bootstrap6-drawer-initial-focus-both requires both kinds of drawer; this patch fails it, and one earlier model patch (42ce55e5) passes it.
